name: Vegetation greenness (NDVI)
description: How green and dense the vegetation looks from space, from -1 to 1. Dense Amazon forest stays near 0.8; the index saturates over closed canopy, so a drop signals strong change.

name: Vegetation greenness (EVI)
description: Like NDVI but less saturated over dense forest, so it shows more detail where the canopy is closed.

name: Daytime land surface temperature
description: How hot the ground surface is in the morning overpass, measured from space. Forest keeps the surface cooler than cleared land. Shown until 2020: later, the satellite's orbit drift biases it.

name: Rainfall
description: Monthly rain from NASA's satellite constellation, calibrated with rain gauges. Helps tell a drought from forest loss.

name: Burned area
description: Share of the cell that burned that month, mapped from MODIS at 500 m. Fire and tree cover loss often occur in the same places; that alone does not show which caused which.
slopeUnits: % of cell per year, per decade
